title: Minimal Reproducible Example
text:
1 Quarto Reprex (via GitHub Actions on Linux)

Code

  nhanes,
  maxit = 2,

  data = imp,

# Pool results across models

# Summarize pooled results
fit_pooled

# Load libraries
library("mice")
#> 
#> Attaching package: 'mice'

# Impute data
imp <- mice::mice(
  nhanes,
  maxit = 2,
  m = 2)
#>

#>   1   1  bmi  hyp  chl
#>   1   2  bmi  hyp  chl

  data = imp,
  exp = lm(bmi ~ hyp + chl))
